notes.title: 游戏重要的更新
notes.content:
1、将游戏中初始的雪球增大了，这样可以减少不必要的等待和操作。
2、将游戏中重复且难度较大的地方进行了修改，降低了游戏难度。

notes.title: 游戏bug修复
notes.content: 将之前游戏bug修复，经测试已正常运行，给您带来的困惑敬请原谅！

notes.title: Important update
notes.content: The game has added language options and reduced the difficulty of very difficult levels, which makes the player feel more pleasant and worth trying.
